summary.zh-Hans: 奥克兰天空塔设有观景层，可以环看城市与豪拉基湾一带。
summary.en: Auckland’s Sky Tower has observation levels with panoramic views over the city and Hauraki Gulf.

summary.zh-Hans: 奥克兰植物园种植来自世界各地的植物，园内设有香草园、玫瑰园和针叶植物园等不同植物区。
summary.en: Auckland Botanic Gardens grows plants from around the world in collections including herb, rose and conifer gardens.

summary.zh-Hans: 在奥克兰可以吃到裹面糊炸制的鱼配薯条，鱼的酥脆外层与薯条一同装盘。
summary.en: Auckland serves battered fish with chips, pairing a crisp coating with the potato side.

summary.zh-Hans: Hokey pokey 将冰淇淋与酥脆的蜂窝糖块搭配，常以香草冰淇淋为底，在奥克兰也能品尝到。
summary.en: Hokey pokey combines ice cream with crunchy honeycomb pieces, commonly in a vanilla base. It is also served in Auckland.
